body.message:
Good morning Assem Taji,

We have checked the booking and would like to inform you that, due to a system error, we received a booking through our website even though the unit is not available.

Please note that your booking is not confirmed, and unfortunately, we are unable to accommodate the booking. It will therefore be cancelled automatically.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding.

Thank you.
